definitions.explanation: A fence made of bamboo, characteristic of Japanese gardens, temple grounds, and traditional residences. Various styles exist (e.g., {四目垣|よつめがき} open lattice, {建仁寺垣|けんにんじがき} vertical screen).

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{竹垣|たけがき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{囲|かこ}んだ→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧。
examples.english: I enclosed the garden with a bamboo fence.
There was an old bamboo fence around the temple.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{町家|まちや}→町家：22291_machiya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{細|ほそ}い→細い：02962_hosoi⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧{竹垣|たけがき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: In Kyoto's traditional townhouses, low bamboo fences run along the narrow streets.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{竹|たけ}→竹：02220_take⟧ (bamboo) + {垣|かき} (fence; the kanji shifts to ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ as the second element). Bamboo fences are emblematic of Japanese garden design and come in many named styles.

COMMON STYLES:
- {四目垣|よつめがき}: open four-square lattice fence (common in tea gardens)
- {建仁寺垣|けんにんじがき}: vertical solid bamboo screen (named after Kennin-ji)
- {御簾垣|みすがき}: horizontal blind-style fence

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {竹垣|たけがき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{囲|かこ}う→囲う：12005_kakou⟧: to enclose with a bamboo fence
- {竹垣|たけがき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{結|ゆ}う: to construct (tie together) a bamboo fence
- ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{竹垣|たけがき}: an old bamboo fence
